digest.component_or_area: Jira DataCenter adapter — authentication & credential handling
propositions: When JIRA_PAT environment variable is absent, the adapter falls back to anonymous access instead of raising an error naming the variable, contradicting the documented security guarantee.

An empty or whitespace-only JIRA_PAT is accepted and passed as bearer token, causing requests to be sent as anonymous, which misattributes failures to missing projects rather than missing credentials.
Settings resolution must remain total (not raise on missing PAT) to preserve Python 3.11 Protocol conformance checks via hasattr, so validation must occur at client construction time instead.
The credential guard must explicitly name JIRA_PAT and note it is environment-only, since the most likely user mistake is placing it in a config file, which the guide forbids.
